title: DID (Decentralized Identifier)
summary: A DID is a W3C standard identifier: did:method:method-specific-id. The method defines how the DID is resolved (e.g., did:key, did:web, did:ethr, did:ion). DIDs are self-sovereign (no central authority) and resolve to DID documents (JSON containing public keys, service endpoints).

notes: Methods: key (self-contained), web (DNS-based), ethr (Ethereum), ion (Bitcoin/Sidetree), etc.
DID document: JSON with @context, id, verificationMethod, authentication, service, etc.
DIDs are used in verifiable credentials, self-sovereign identity, and Web3.
DID resolution: given a DID, retrieve the DID document (via universal resolver).
